verses.html: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.html: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.text: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.html: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.text: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

verses.html: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.text: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.html: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.text: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

verses.html: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.text: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

verses.html: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.text: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

verses.html: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.text: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

verses.html: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.text: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

verses.html: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

verses.html: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.text: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

verses.html: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.text: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

verses.html: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

verses.html: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.text: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

verses.html: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.text: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

verses.html: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.text: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

verses.html: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.text: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

verses.html: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.text: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

verses.html: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.text: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

verses.html: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.text: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

verses.html: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.text: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
